name: Stories of Aetas Valon: Respite in the Core
source:
In the midst of his busy life, split between taking care of his family, working, and studying, Lysander finds the time to take a short respite. Spending a night out in the forest with his close friend, Hati. 

[From [url=https://lucentstudios.itch.io/respite-in-the-core]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在忙于照顾家庭、工作和学习的生活中，Lysander找到了短暂休息的时间。和他的好朋友哈蒂在森林里度过了一个夜晚。

[来自[url=https://lucentstudios.itch.io/respite-in-the-core]Itch.io[/url]]
